_comment: Service registry template. Copy to services.json (gitignored); the UI writes it as you add services. `type` is process (host-spawned) or container (Docker-managed). `surface` describes what the service IS — web|server|desktop|cli|job — and decides how 'running' is judged: web/server = a port is probed; desktop/cli = its process is tracked; job = the last run's exit code. A service with no `surface` behaves like the old port-based model. Delete these examples once you add your own.
name: Example (container-first, recommended)
